name: Progress
summary: The one operation indicator, in two forms: a compact turning arc, and a bar that fills to a known share or carries a travelling segment when the total isn't known. No separate Spinner. Not for content loading: views and sections of known shape load as a Skeleton.
a11y: Hidden inside a control that sets `aria-busy`; with `label` it is a `progressbar` with that name, and with a `value` its `aria-valuenow`. The words beside it (the step, the count) carry the state as well as the motion. With `showLabel` the visible label names it (`aria-labelledby`) and `valueText` is said as its `aria-valuetext`. Reduced motion stops the arc and holds the bar's segment still; `delay` keeps its timing.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name when the indicator stands alone, e.g. "Importing pictures". Omit inside a control that already says it's busy.

props.name: form
props.description: `inline`: the compact turning arc, inside a busy Button, Switch or field, or beside a short line of text. `bar`: a thin line under the work it measures, for operations and app-level work.

props.name: value
props.description: Bar only: the share done, 0–100, from a real total (bytes, items, steps). Leave out when the total isn't known; never invent one.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Bar only: shows the label above the bar at its start, and the value at its end (the percentage when it's known).

props.name: valueText
props.description: Bar only: the count in words, e.g. "18 of 40 files"; shown before the percentage and said instead of it.

props.name: delay
props.description: Shows nothing for the first 300 ms (`duration.indicator-delay`), so work that ends sooner never flashes an indicator. Once shown, keep it at least 500 ms.
